name: com.cholushkin.feelmotion
description: Inspector-first animation and game-juice library for Unity: LitMotion's performance with a FEEL-like authoring workflow — tween sequences and side effects (transform, UI, camera, material, audio, physics, TextMeshPro...), built entirely in the Inspector.

samples.description: CatFlyer (AaaahFlyingCat) demo — inspector-authored, code-authored, and plain variants — plus a Callbacks demo. Includes scenes, prefabs, demo scripts and art.
